name: E-MOORM
notes: Today's menu: see what food shops have ready now, or pre-order for later, and sellers post and edit their menu in the app.
Delivery by a MoorMove rider at checkout, with the fee shown before you order; sellers can call a rider, cancel one, or deliver it themselves.
See products in 3D and, on supported phones, view them in your space.
Opening a shop is five short steps, and each shop sets a delivery fee for every place it delivers to, or free delivery.
Shop QR posters to save and share, a fresher home page, and smoother menus.
